dashboard.lead: A calm place: what is yours, and nothing more.
dashboard.stopsDescription: Your organisation sets how long a moment lasts and how many there are. Defaults shown.
dashboard.momentsDescription: The moments you had, newest first.
dashboard.momentsEmpty: Each moment will be listed here with the day, and how you felt before and after, in your words. Nothing is inferred.
dashboard.keepDescription: A few lines you read, edit or delete.
dashboard.keepEmpty: When a moment ends, the transcript is gone. What stays is a short summary that is yours.
dashboard.threadDescription: What you chose to carry into your next moment.
dashboard.threadEmpty: The thread starts with the first summary you keep.
dashboard.notebookDescription: Everything you kept, in one place.
dashboard.notebookEmpty: It fills as you keep summaries. You can export it as one page.
dashboard.begin: A listening space with a face and a voice, whenever you are ready.

members.caption: Members
members.name: Name

moment.title: A moment
moment.lead: A listening space with a face and a voice. Choose who you would like to talk with.
moment.chooseTitle: Who would you like to talk with?
moment.styleLea: Listens and reflects back what you say.
moment.styleSamuel: Asks open questions so you can step back.
moment.styleNoor: Helps you find one small step.
moment.aiNote: {name} is an AI presence, not a person and not an emergency service.
moment.opening: I'm {name}, an AI presence. I'm not a therapist and not an emergency service. Tell me what is on your mind, and I will listen.
moment.limits: A moment lasts up to {minutes} minutes. It stops on time.
moment.keepText: Nothing of what you say is saved. The words are held only while the moment lasts, then they are gone. This is a development build, not yet reviewed by a lawyer.
moment.agree: I have read what is kept
moment.agreeFirst: Read and tick what is kept to begin.
moment.unavailableTitle: Moments are not available right now
moment.unavailableText: Nothing is answering at the moment. If you want to talk to someone now, the lines are always open.
moment.placeholder: Say what is on your mind
moment.endedText: Nothing was saved. You can come back when the next moment opens.
moment.crisisTitle: Someone can listen to you right now
moment.crisisStopped: {name} stops here. The lines below are open now.
moment.declinedTitle: A question for someone who knows you
moment.stopsDay: That is all for today. See you again from {time}.
moment.stopsWeek: That is all for this week. See you again from {time}.
